unlisted_practices: Institutional social influence and leadership endorsement to drive clinician adoption of LLM tools
Assessing technology acceptance (UTAUT and perceived risk) among clinicians using a deployed LLM

screen.reason: The study surveyed 392 healthcare professionals in a hospital where DeepSeek was deployed to analyze determinants of adoption/acceptance using UTAUT; it evaluates clinician acceptance in a real deployment rather than testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice intervention.
